zh.consequence: 清军击败明郑，台湾纳入清朝版图。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Seven Years’ War
en.consequence: A global war reshapes colonies and great-power ranks — sometimes called a first world war.

de.name: Siebenjähriger Krieg
de.consequence: Ein globaler Krieg formt Kolonien und Großmächte neu.

zh.name: 七年战争
zh.consequence: 全球性战争重塑殖民地与列强格局，常被视为“第一次世界大战”雏形。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Canton System tightened
en.consequence: Qing limits European trade to Canton — shaping later conflicts over open ports.

de.name: Kanton-System verschärft
de.consequence: Qing begrenzt Europahandel auf Kanton — prägt spätere Hafenkonflikte.

zh.name: 一口通商（广州）收紧
zh.consequence: 清朝限制对欧贸易于广州——影响后来通商口岸冲突。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Industrial Revolution begins
en.consequence: Machines and factories change work, cities, and global power.

de.name: Beginn der Industriellen Revolution
de.consequence: Maschinen und Fabriken verändern Arbeit, Städte und Weltmacht.

zh.name: 工业革命开始
zh.consequence: 机器与工厂改变劳动、城市与全球力量。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: American independence (European impact)
en.consequence: A new republic inspires political debates in Eurasia.

de.name: Amerikanische Unabhängigkeit (europäische Wirkung)
de.consequence: Eine neue Republik inspiriert politische Debatten in Eurasien.

zh.name: 美国独立（对欧洲影响）
zh.consequence: 新共和国激发欧亚政治讨论。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: French Revolution
en.consequence: Rights, citizenship, and modern politics reshape Europe.

de.name: Französische Revolution
de.consequence: Rechte, Bürgerschaft und moderne Politik formen Europa neu.

zh.name: 法国大革命
zh.consequence: 权利、公民身份与现代政治重塑欧洲。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Macartney Embassy
en.consequence: Britain asks for freer trade; Qing refuses — a famous clash of worldviews.

de.name: Macartney-Gesandtschaft
de.consequence: Britannien will freieren Handel; Qing lehnt ab — berühmter Weltbild-Konflikt.

zh.name: 马戛尔尼使团
zh.consequence: 英使求扩大通商，清廷拒绝——著名的文明观念碰撞。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Napoleonic Wars
en.consequence: Wars spread legal codes and redraw the map of Europe.

de.name: Napoleonische Kriege
de.consequence: Kriege verbreiten Gesetzeswerke und zeichnen Europas Karte neu.

zh.name: 拿破仑战争
zh.consequence: 战争传播法典并重绘欧洲地图。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Congress of Vienna
en.consequence: After Napoleon, powers redraw Europe’s map and try to keep a balance of power.

de.name: Wiener Kongress
de.consequence: Nach Napoleon zeichnen Mächte Europas Karte neu und suchen Machtgleichgewicht.

zh.name: 维也纳会议
zh.consequence: 拿破仑战后列强重划欧洲地图，试图维持均势。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: First Opium War
en.consequence: Unequal treaties open Chinese ports to foreign power.

de.name: Erster Opiumkrieg
de.consequence: Ungleiche Verträge öffnen chinesische Häfen für fremde Macht.

zh.name: 第一次鸦片战争
zh.consequence: 不平等条约迫使中国港口对列强开放。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Revolutions of 1848
en.consequence: People demand constitutions and nations — even when crushed, ideas keep spreading.

de.name: Revolutionen 1848
de.consequence: Menschen fordern Verfassungen und Nationen — Ideen wirken weiter.

zh.name: 1848年欧洲革命
zh.consequence: 民众要求宪法与民族国家——虽遭镇压，思想继续传播。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Taiping Rebellion begins
en.consequence: A massive civil war kills millions and shakes the Qing state.

de.name: Beginn des Taiping-Aufstands
de.consequence: Ein riesiger Bürgerkrieg kostet Millionen und erschüttert die Qing.

zh.name: 太平天国起事
zh.consequence: 大规模内战死亡数百万，严重动摇清朝统治。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Meiji Restoration
en.consequence: Japan rapidly modernizes industry and the state.

de.name: Meiji-Restauration
de.consequence: Japan modernisiert rasch Industrie und Staat.

zh.name: 明治维新
zh.consequence: 日本迅速现代化工业与国家。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: German Empire proclaimed
en.consequence: German states unite under Prussia — a new great power sits in the middle of Europe.

de.name: Deutsches Kaiserreich ausgerufen
de.consequence: Deutsche Staaten einigen sich unter Preußen — eine neue Großmacht.

zh.name: 德意志帝国宣告成立
zh.consequence: 德意志各邦在普鲁士主导下统一——欧洲中部出现新列强。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Treaty of Shimonoseki
en.consequence: Qing loses to Japan and cedes Taiwan — East Asia’s power balance shifts.

de.name: Vertrag von Shimonoseki
de.consequence: Qing unterliegt Japan und tritt Taiwan ab — Machtbalance in Ostasien ändert sich.

zh.name: 马关条约
zh.consequence: 清朝战败割让台湾——东亚力量对比剧变。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: World War I
en.consequence: Industrial war topples empires and remakes borders.

de.name: Erster Weltkrieg
de.consequence: Industrieller Krieg stürzt Reiche und formt Grenzen neu.

zh.name: 第一次世界大战
zh.consequence: 工业化战争推翻帝国并重塑边界。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Russian Revolution
en.consequence: Tsardom ends; a socialist state emerges.

de.name: Russische Revolution
de.consequence: Zarenreich endet; ein sozialistischer Staat entsteht.

zh.name: 俄国革命
zh.consequence: 沙皇统治结束；社会主义国家出现。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: May Fourth Movement
en.consequence: Students protest the Versailles deal on Shandong — a spark for modern Chinese politics and culture.

de.name: Bewegung des 4. Mai
de.consequence: Studenten protestieren gegen Versailles wegen Shandong — Impuls für moderne Politik und Kultur.

zh.name: 五四运动
zh.consequence: 学生抗议凡尔赛山东条款——推动中国近现代政治与文化变革。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Treaty of Versailles
en.consequence: WWI peace terms reshape borders and anger — helping set the stage for later conflict.

de.name: Versailler Vertrag
de.consequence: Friedensbedingungen formen Grenzen und Unmut — und spätere Konflikte mit.

zh.name: 凡尔赛条约
zh.consequence: 一战和约重划边界并埋下怨恨，影响后来冲突。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: World War II
en.consequence: Global war causes immense loss and a new world order.

de.name: Zweiter Weltkrieg
de.consequence: Weltkrieg verursacht enorme Verluste und eine neue Weltordnung.

zh.name: 第二次世界大战
zh.consequence: 全球战争造成巨大损失并形成新世界秩序。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: People’s Republic of China founded
en.consequence: Communist victory ends the Chinese Civil War phase.

de.name: Gründung der Volksrepublik China
de.consequence: Kommunistischer Sieg beendet die Phase des Bürgerkriegs.

zh.name: 中华人民共和国成立
zh.consequence: 共产党胜利结束内战阶段。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: European integration
en.consequence: Coal & Steel to EU: nations bind economies to keep peace.

de.name: Europäische Integration
de.consequence: Von Kohle & Stahl zur EU: Staaten binden Wirtschaft für Frieden.

zh.name: 欧洲一体化
zh.consequence: 从煤钢联营到欧盟：国家以经济联合维护和平。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: Fall of the Berlin Wall
en.consequence: The Cold War barrier opens — a symbol that Eastern Europe’s communist order is ending.

de.name: Fall der Berliner Mauer
de.consequence: Die Kalter-Krieg-Grenze öffnet sich — Symbol für das Ende der kommunistischen Ordnung.

zh.name: 柏林墙倒塌
zh.consequence: 冷战壁垒开放——象征东欧冷战秩序走向终结。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map

en.name: World Wide Web goes public
en.consequence: Instant information connects Eurasian societies anew.

de.name: World Wide Web wird öffentlich
de.consequence: Sofortige Information verbindet eurasische Gesellschaften neu.

zh.name: 万维网公开
zh.consequence: 即时信息重新连接欧亚社会。

image.credit: Original educational illustration created for Eurasia History Map
